hpe_js_mutation_state.brief: 取（必要时创建）解释器的 MutationObserver 状态 / Get, creating on demand, the interpreter's MutationObserver state

params.js: JS 运行时上下文，可为 `NULL` / JS runtime context, may be `NULL`

hpe_js_mutation_state.return: 解释器级状态块；`js` 为 `NULL` 时返回 `NULL` / The per-interpreter state block, or `NULL` when `js` is `NULL`
hpe_js_mutation_state.note: 状态块从 arena 分配并清零，首次调用时缓存到 `js->mutation_state` / The block is arena-allocated, zeroed and cached in `js->mutation_state` on first use

record_new.brief: 分配一条待投递的变更记录 / Allocate a pending mutation record

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context

record_new.return: 已清零的新记录 / The new zeroed record

record_push.brief: 把记录追加到观察者的待投递链表尾 / Append a record to the tail of the observer's pending list

params.r: inout:要入队的记录 / The record to enqueue

record_push.note: 链表为空时同时设置头指针 / Sets the head pointer too when the list was empty

observes_node.brief: 判断观察者是否监听了该节点 / Test whether the observer watches a node

params.target: 变更发生的节点 / The node that changed

observes_node.return: 命中返回 1 / 1 when the node is watched
observes_node.note: 未开启 `subtree` 时只匹配观察目标本身，否则沿 `parent` 向上查找 / Without `subtree` only the observed node itself matches; otherwise ancestors are walked via `parent`

attr_passes_filter.brief: 判断属性名是否通过 `attributeFilter` 过滤 / Test whether an attribute name passes the `attributeFilter`

params.name: 变更的属性名，可为 `NULL` / The changed attribute name, may be `NULL`

attr_passes_filter.return: 通过返回 1 / 1 when the attribute passes
attr_passes_filter.note: 未设置过滤表时全部通过；设置了过滤表但属性名为 `NULL` 则不通过 / Everything passes without a filter list; with one, a `NULL` name fails

record_to_object.brief: 把内部记录转换为 MutationRecord 对象 / Convert an internal record into a MutationRecord object

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.o: 所属观察者（决定是否带 `oldValue`）/ The owning observer, which decides whether `oldValue` is included
params.r: 待转换的记录 / The record to convert

record_to_object.return: 形如 `{ type, target, attributeName, oldValue }` 的普通对象 / A plain object with `type`, `target`, `attributeName` and `oldValue`
record_to_object.details: `type` 由记录种类映射为 `attributes`/`characterData`/`childList`；`oldValue` 仅在观察者开启对应 `*OldValue` 时给出，否则为 `null`。| The record kind maps `type` to `attributes`, `characterData` or `childList`; `oldValue` is only present when the observer enabled the matching `*OldValue` option, otherwise it is `null`.

take_records_value.brief: 取出观察者的全部待投递记录并清空队列 / Take all pending records of an observer, clearing its queue

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context

take_records_value.return: 记录对象构成的数组 / An array of record objects
take_records_value.note: 取出后头尾指针清零并同步写入 `length` / The head and tail pointers are cleared and `length` is written

observer_deliver.brief: 投递微任务体：把已入队记录交给回调 / The delivery microtask body: hand the queued records to the callback

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.thisv: 调用时的 `this`（未使用）/ The `this` of the call (unused)
params.args: 实参数组（未使用）/ Argument array (unused)
params.argc: 参数个数（未使用）/ Argument count (unused)
params.ud: 透传的观察者指针 / The observer pointer passed through

observer_deliver.note: 先清除 `queued` 标志；无待投递记录时不做任何事，否则以记录数组为唯一实参调用回调 / The `queued` flag is cleared first; with no pending records it returns, otherwise the callback is invoked with the records array as its only argument

queue_delivery.brief: 为一个观察者排入投递微任务 / Queue a delivery microtask for an observer

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context

queue_delivery.note: 已有待投递微任务时直接返回；否则置 `queued` 标志并投递 `observer_deliver` / Returns immediately when a delivery is already pending, otherwise sets `queued` and queues `observer_deliver`

mutation_bridge.brief: DOM 变更接收器：为匹配的观察者生成记录 / DOM mutation sink: create records for the observers that match

params.ud: 透传的 JS 上下文 / The JS context passed through
params.kind: 变更种类（`HPE_MUT_*`）/ Mutation kind, one of `HPE_MUT_*`
params.target: 发生变更的 DOM 节点 / The DOM node that changed
params.name: 属性名（属性变更时）/ The attribute name for attribute mutations
params.old_value: 变更前的旧值，可为 `NULL` / The previous value, may be `NULL`
params.added: 新增节点（未使用）/ The added node (unused)
params.removed: 被移除节点（未使用）/ The removed node (unused)

mutation_bridge.details: 遍历解释器的观察者链：子节点变更要求 `childList` 且命中节点，属性变更额外要求通过属性过滤，字符数据变更要求 `characterData`；命中者建一条记录并入队投递微任务。| Walks the interpreter's observer list: a child-list change requires `childList` and a watched node, an attribute change also needs to pass the filter, and a character-data change requires `characterData`; a hit builds a record and queues a delivery microtask.

hpe_js_mutation_install.brief: 注册 DOM 变更接收器 / Register the DOM mutation sink

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context

hpe_js_mutation_install.note: 每个解释器只注册一次（由 `sink_installed` 保证），接收器经 `hpe_dom_add_mutation_sink` 挂到 DOM 层 / Registers once per interpreter guarded by `sink_installed`, attaching the bridge through `hpe_dom_add_mutation_sink`

hpe_js_mutation_uninstall.brief: 注销 DOM 变更接收器 / Unregister the DOM mutation sink

params.js: JS 运行时上下文，可为 `NULL` / JS runtime context, may be `NULL`

hpe_js_mutation_uninstall.note: 未注册时不做任何事，否则摘除接收器并清 `sink_installed` / Does nothing when not installed, otherwise removes the sink and clears `sink_installed`

observer_observe.brief: `MutationObserver.prototype.observe`：开始监听目标节点 / `MutationObserver.prototype.observe`: start watching a target node

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.thisv: 调用时的 `this`（未使用）/ The `this` of the call (unused)
params.args: 实参数组：`[目标节点, 选项对象]` / Argument array: `[target node, options object]`
params.ud: 透传的观察者指针 / The observer pointer passed through

observer_observe.details: 目标须为 `HPE_HOST_ELEMENT` 或 `HPE_HOST_FRAGMENT` 宿主值；从选项对象读取 `childList`/`attributes`/`characterData`/`subtree`/`attributeOldValue`/`characterDataOldValue` 与 `attributeFilter`。| The target must be a `HPE_HOST_ELEMENT` or `HPE_HOST_FRAGMENT` host value; the options object supplies `childList`, `attributes`, `characterData`, `subtree`, `attributeOldValue`, `characterDataOldValue` and `attributeFilter`.
observer_observe.note: 缺少选项对象时只记录目标不设任何监听开关；过滤器条目经 `ToString` 复制 / Without an options object only the target is recorded and no watch flags are set; filter entries are copied as strings

observer_disconnect.brief: `MutationObserver.prototype.disconnect`：停止监听并丢弃待投递记录 / `MutationObserver.prototype.disconnect`: stop watching and drop pending records

params.js: JS 运行时上下文（未使用）/ JS runtime context (unused)
params.thisv: 调用时的 `this`（未使用）/ The `this` of the call (unused)
params.args: 实参数组（未使用）/ Argument array (unused)
params.argc: 参数个数（未使用）/ Argument count (unused)
params.ud: 透传的观察者指针 / The observer pointer passed through

observer_disconnect.note: 清空目标、待投递记录链与 `queued` 标志 / Clears the target, the pending record list and the `queued` flag

observer_take_records.brief: `MutationObserver.prototype.takeRecords`：取走并清空待投递记录 / `MutationObserver.prototype.takeRecords`: take and clear the pending records

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.thisv: 调用时的 `this`（未使用）/ The `this` of the call (unused)
params.args: 实参数组（未使用）/ Argument array (unused)
params.argc: 参数个数（未使用）/ Argument count (unused)
params.ud: 透传的观察者指针 / The observer pointer passed through

observer_take_records.return: 记录对象数组 / An array of record objects
observer_take_records.note: 观察者指针为空时返回空数组 / Returns an empty array when the observer pointer is `NULL`

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.thisv: 调用时的 `this`（未使用）/ The `this` of the call (unused)
params.args: 实参数组：`[回调]` / Argument array: `[callback]`
params.ud: 用户数据（未使用）/ User data (unused)

observer_ctor.return: 新的 MutationObserver 宿主值 / The new MutationObserver host value
observer_ctor.details: 分配并清零观察者结构，首参存为回调，注册到解释器状态链，并把 `observe`/`disconnect`/`takeRecords` 作为自身属性挂上。| The observer struct is allocated and zeroed, the first argument is stored as the callback, the observer is linked into the interpreter state and `observe`, `disconnect` and `takeRecords` are attached as own properties.

hpe_js_mutation_install_ctor.brief: 安装全局 `MutationObserver` 构造器 / Install the global `MutationObserver` constructor

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context

hpe_js_mutation_install_ctor.note: `js` 为 `NULL` 时直接返回；否则把带 `name` 的原生函数写入 `global.MutationObserver` / Returns early when `js` is `NULL`; otherwise the native function with a `name` property is stored in `global.MutationObserver`
